-1.stdout:
usage: pseudolife-mcp backup [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--out OUT] [--keep-days KEEP_DAYS]
                             [--container CONTAINER] [--daemon-container DAEMON_CONTAINER]
                             [--db DB] [--user USER] [--db-port DB_PORT]

Back up the memory bank (pg_dump + state archive).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   bank data dir (default: PSEUDOLIFE_MCP_DATA_DIR, the lite tier's per-user
                        dir, or ./data)
  --out OUT             destination dir (default: <data-dir>/backups)
  --keep-days KEEP_DAYS
                        rotate this tool's own backups older than N days (default 7)
  --container CONTAINER
                        Docker PostgreSQL container
  --daemon-container DAEMON_CONTAINER
                        Docker daemon container
  --db DB               Docker database name (default: daemon configuration)
  --user USER           Docker database role (default: daemon configuration)
  --db-port DB_PORT     PostgreSQL port inside the Docker container (default: daemon
                        configuration)
